about: Swedbank register (SW-D07). Rules and public figures only; read by scripts/swedbank_pulse/ask.py and the complaint rules. Sources bound to docs/swedbank/research_pack.md (17 Nov 2026). Rows not backed by law say 'confirm with the bank'.

entries.label: First reply to a complaint
entries.value: 15 business days (bank standard, confirm with the bank)
entries.basis: Bank standard used for the first-reply clock; no statutory 8-week clock applies in Sweden
entries.status: Bank standard: confirm with the bank

entries.label: Reply to a payment-services complaint
entries.basis: Payment-services complaint rule (Payment Services Act, betaltjänstlagen, implementing the EU rule): a reply within 15 business days, 35 in exceptional cases

entries.label: Bank's final decision
entries.value: Bank standard: confirm with the bank
entries.basis: Swedbank's complaint process: Kundcenter or branch (kontor), then a written appeal to the Kundombudsman, then ARN
entries.status: Bank standard: confirm with the bank

entries.label: Kundombudsman appeal
entries.value: Written appeal to the bank's Kundombudsman (the bank's internal appeal) after the final decision
entries.basis: Second-line complaints appeal inside the bank, the stage before ARN

entries.label: ARN (Allmänna reklamationsnämnden)
entries.value: The customer files in writing after the bank's final decision; 150 kr fee; recommendations are not binding but banks follow them

entries.label: Unauthorised transaction refund
entries.basis: Payment Services Act (betaltjänstlagen): refund an unauthorised transaction by the next business day; manipulated transfers are investigated, and ARN has ruled that Swish payments the customer made are not unauthorised transactions

entries.label: Finansinspektionen (FI) focus areas
entries.value: Payment-account access · fraud handling · vulnerable customers · clear information
entries.basis: FI consumer-protection supervision and the right to a payment account (betalkonto)

entries.label: Konsumenternas Bank- och finansbyrå cases
entries.value: About 7,500 cases in 2025 (9,100 in 2024), led by fraud and account measures under the money-laundering rules
entries.basis: Independent consumer guidance body, all banks

entries.label: Bank-initiated account closures
entries.value: 159,000 in three years across the big banks
entries.basis: Finansinspektionen called in Handelsbanken, SEB, Nordea and Swedbank

entries.label: SKI Bank 2026, private customers
entries.basis: Svenskt Kvalitetsindex, about 23,000 interviews in August 2026; below 60 counts as a fail

entries.label: NKI target, Sweden
entries.basis: Swedbank's own satisfaction target; Sweden was below it in 2025
